_comment: Change-detection state for the spec monitor. body_sha256 = SHA-256 of the page markdown body as returned by getConfluencePage(contentFormat=markdown) and written to the baseline file via `jq -r '.content.nodes[0].body'`. The scheduled run recomputes the hash the same way and compares; identical hash => no change => stay silent.
schedule: cron 7 */5 * * * UTC = every 5 hours at :07 (00/05/10/15/20 UTC)
